walkthroughs.body_html: The Great Depression, Weimar political fragmentation, fear of communism and conservative elites' miscalculation paved Hitler's path. Appointed Chancellor on 30 January 1933, he exploited the Reichstag Fire and the Enabling Act to neutralise opposition within months.

The process of Gleichschaltung (coordination) brought trade unions, parties and civil society under Nazi control. The SS, Gestapo and concentration camp system silenced dissent, while propaganda under Goebbels mobilised consent. Rearmament breached Versailles and prepared the ground for aggressive expansion.

Germany's invasion of Poland on 1 September 1939 began WWII in Europe. Conquests across the continent and the invasion of the USSR (Operation Barbarossa, June 1941) facilitated genocide: the murder of approximately six million Jews, alongside Roma, disabled people, Soviet POWs and others. Defeat at Stalingrad (1942-43), Kursk (1943) and on the Western Front led to Berlin's fall and Hitler's suicide on 30 April 1945.

mcqs.q: Why was Jenner's smallpox vaccination significant in 1796?
options: He showed cowpox material could prevent smallpox safely — the first effective vaccine, though he did not know why it worked; germ theory came nearly a century later.
Jenner discovered germs and used them to make vaccines.
Jenner used penicillin to cure smallpox.
Chartism failed because Queen Victoria personally banned the movement.

mcqs.q: Did the Wall Street Crash cause the Great Depression?
options: The Wall Street Crash on its own caused the Great Depression.
It triggered it but the underlying causes were over-production, agricultural slump, weak banking regulation, and uneven wealth — the Crash exposed structural problems.
Chartism failed because Queen Victoria personally banned the movement.
The Wall Street Crash happened because the US joined WWII.

mcqs.q: Why did Chartism fail in the short term?
options: Chartism failed because Queen Victoria personally banned the movement.
Chartism failed because no one supported it.
Jenner used penicillin to cure smallpox.
Mass petitions were rejected by Parliament; the movement split between moral-force and physical-force wings; economic improvement after 1848 reduced support.
